notes: CPU medians are primary; elapsed medians can be affected by host load.
One warmup followed by five repetitions; backtrim, duplicate columns, probability and rmseq have seven final repetitions.
The initial duplicate matcher also allocated objects for unique columns. A final lazy construction removed that overhead; both initial and final backtrim trials are retained.
Output fingerprints exclude stderr diagnostics, which intentionally abbreviate large duplicate candidate lists.
RSS is a fresh worker-process high-water mark including imports, inputs, warmup and output checking.
PLM cache benchmark uses a synthetic local ESM and scalar window batches to compare bitwise outputs. It does not measure biological accuracy or large pretrained models.
Some workers ran before the version bump; cdskit_version in environment metadata reflects the time of measurement.
